epic.name: Hybrid Routing Web Portal Integration
epic.description: Integrate CLI hybrid routing workers with existing web portal for real-time progress monitoring, cost tracking, and CFN Loop visualization. Replaces tmux approach with browser-based multi-user monitoring. Includes foundation quality fixes from HYBRID_ROUTING_HANDOFF.md before portal integration.
objectives: Complete Sprint 3 quality fixes: SQLite tests (54/54 passing), 502 retry logic, timeout logging
Enable real-time visibility of hybrid routing workers in web portal
Visualize CFN Loop progress (Loop 3 iterations, Loop 4 decisions) in browser
Track cost savings (z.ai vs Claude) in portal dashboard
Support multi-user team monitoring of agent coordination
Provide historical search and export of hybrid routing events
epic.business_value: 97% cost savings visibility + remote team monitoring + historical audit trail + production-ready quality

tasks.title: Implement Worker Retry Logic for 502 Errors
tasks.description: Add exponential backoff retry (1s, 2s, 4s) to handle z.ai API 502 errors (from HYBRID_ROUTING_HANDOFF.md Medium Priority #4)
acceptance_criteria: spawnWorkerWithRetry() method with maxRetries=3
Exponential backoff delays: 1s, 2s, 4s
Retry only on 502 errors (not 401, 403, 429, etc.)
Log retry attempts: '⚠️ Worker N 502 error, retry M/3 in Xs'
Target: <1% failure rate (from current ~10%)
tasks.reference: HYBRID_ROUTING_HANDOFF.md - Known Issues #1: z.ai API 502 Errors

tasks.title: Improve Worker Timeout Detection

acceptance_criteria: Timeout message logged: '⏱️ TIMEOUT: Workers exceeded 30-minute limit'
